name: Vera Verdecktes
personality: She gives nothing away except the impression that everyone else already has.
visual_intent: Tall tapering ink bell,side quiff,subtle lashes,one slowly raised eyelid and tiny closed superior smirk;small green felt eyeshade pushed ABOVE eyes and burgundy collar;holds exactly TWO thick ivory playing cards showing plain backs against her flank
biography: She gives nothing away except the impression that everyone else already has. Her HyperNorm neighbours are either readable or hiding something, a rule from which she tactfully exempts herself. The two backed cards are less a hand than a border. A dissonant card suggests that privacy need not be deception. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie lässt sich nichts anmerken. Die Anmerkungen verwaltet jemand anders.

name: Bodo Bluffbedarf
personality: He bluffs with the expression of someone requesting permission to lie.
visual_intent: Wide wobbly ink pear,huge nervous side-glancing eyes and clenched teeth clearly INSIDE open tense mouth;small burgundy bowtie and cream collar;holds one short stack of three large poker chips between trembling goo hands
biography: He bluffs with the expression of someone requesting permission to lie. He stacks three chips like supporting evidence and sorts every question into believed or personally disastrous. The residents' club rewards confidence, so he practises sweating quietly. He once found a dissonant card and has been pretending not to understand it. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Er blufft überzeugend. Leider nur sich selbst.

name: Kurt Kalkül
personality: He can calculate every outcome except the one involving people.
visual_intent: Narrow angular-in-outline but smoothly rounded three-lobed ink blob,heavy skeptical brows and pursed toothless mouth;small green visor cap and cream collar;holds a tiny brass pocket abacus with THREE beads,other hand touching chin
biography: He can calculate every outcome except the one involving people. His pocket abacus can reduce an entire courtyard to three beads and two acceptable outcomes. Ambiguity is filed as arithmetic failure. A neighbour who offered him tea without a wager has made the calculations rather inconvenient. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Wahrscheinlichkeit ist geklärt. Das Gegenüber bleibt fehlerhaft.

name: Mona Mitgehen
personality: She calls every bet because exclusion feels more expensive.
visual_intent: Broad squat star-lobed ink blob,soft lashed lids,joyful crooked open grin with three upper teeth;small cream neckerchief and burgundy wristband;pushes one oversized single poker chip forward IN OWN cell,other palm open welcoming
biography: She calls every bet because exclusion feels more expensive. She pushes a single enormous chip forward because the building makes belonging conditional on matching the stake. Residents are either in or out. A dissonant card about unconditional company has made her invite the spectators to stay. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie geht mit. Die Richtung gilt als nachrangig.

name: Fiete Fastpleite
personality: He guards his last chip as if it were the deposit on a different life.
visual_intent: Slender drooping comma ink blob,giant worried white eyes downcast toward open palm,tiny closed wavering smile;old burgundy flat cap and green collar;holds ONE tiny lone poker chip in palm and an empty small velvet purse in other hand
biography: He guards his last chip as if it were the deposit on a different life. The last chip and empty purse prove that hope can survive a very small budget. HyperNorm files him as solvent or cautionary example. He has begun keeping a chair free for neighbours who have nothing left to contribute. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Einsatz ist gering. Die Bedeutung wurde entsprechend erhöht.

name: Don Durchgeben
personality: He distributes chance with an air of having personally approved it.
visual_intent: Round broad ink splat with swept crest,alert sideways eyes and toothless asymmetric professional smile;tiny green waistcoat front and cream cuffbands;holds short fan of THREE thick plain-backed cards low at waist,other palm flat in dealer gesture
biography: He distributes chance with an air of having personally approved it. He deals the courtyard its approved possibilities and categorises surprises as procedure or error. The three backed cards make fairness look comfortably manageable. An ambiguous card has persuaded him to shuffle once more when a frightened resident asks. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Er gibt jedem eine Chance. Die Reihenfolge bleibt sein Geschäftsgeheimnis.
